CustomField.formula:
IF(AND(CONTAINS(RecordType.Name, 'Qantas Freight'),OR(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed'),ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Resolved'))), IMAGE("https://qantas.lightning.force.com/servlet/servlet.ImageServer?id=0152v00000IRHhh&oid=00D8s00000IDoz7&lastMod=1647355817000", Text(Status), 30, 30)+' '+Text(Status),
IF(AND(CONTAINS(RecordType.Name, 'Qantas Freight'), (Case_Unresolved_Hours__c <= 24)), IMAGE("https://qantas.lightning.force.com/servlet/servlet.ImageServer?id=0152v00000IRHhi&oid=00D8s00000IDoz7&lastMod=1647355817000", Text(Case_Unresolved_Hours__c), 20, 20)+' '+ Text(Case_Unresolved_Hours__c)+' Hours',
IF(AND(CONTAINS(RecordType.Name, 'Qantas Freight'), (Case_Unresolved_Hours__c > 24)), IMAGE("https://qantas.lightning.force.com/servlet/servlet.ImageServer?id=0152v00000IRHhj&oid=00D8s00000IDoz7&lastMod=1647355817000", Text(Case_Unresolved_Hours__c), 20, 20)+' ' + Text(Case_Unresolved_Hours__c) +' Hours', Text(Status)) ) )
CustomField.label: Case Unresolved Period
